## Structure of the book {.unnumbered}

Chapter [Introduction to R](introduction-to-r.qmd) gives a quick overview of R and its evolution over the last 
2 decades. Chapter [Install R & RStudio](install-r-and-rstudio.qmd) acts as a guide for installing R and 
RStudio. Chapters [Variables in R](variables-in-r.qmd) and [Data Types in R](data-types-in-r.qmd) introduce the reader to 
variables and data types in R. Chapter [Getting Help in R](getting-help-in-r.qmd) shows the right place and right
way to ask for help. Chapters [Vectors in R](vectors-in-r.qmd) to [Lists in R](lists-in-r.qmd) introduce the basic 
data structures in R. Chapter [Install & Update R Packages](install-update-r-packages.qmd) explores the R package system.

## Software information {.unnumbered}

The R session information when compiling this book is shown below:

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```

We do not add prompts (`>` and `+`) to R source code in this book, and we comment out the text output with two hashes `##` by default, as you can see from the R session information above. This is for your convenience when you want to copy and run the code (the text output will be ignored since it is commented out). Package names are in bold text (e.g., **rmarkdown**), and function names are followed by parentheses (e.g., `mean()`). The double-colon operator `::` means accessing an object from a package.
